description: MedNet's registered Open API documentation page. Contains a brief product description, links to EMR Direct's interopengine FHIR API docs, and developer contact info. No b(10) EHI export documentation — only g(7)/g(9) FHIR API references.

EMR Direct Interoperability Engine 2017 Open API documentation. FHIR STU3 Ballot API covering Common Clinical Data Set (20 CCDS elements). This is g(7)/g(9) API documentation, not b(10) EHI export. Linked from MedNet's Open API page.

EMR Direct Interoperability Engine 2026 Open API documentation. FHIR R4 API with US Core IG 6.1, USCDI V3, SMART App Launch, FHIR Bulk Data Access. This is g(10) API documentation, not b(10) EHI export. Not linked from MedNet's page but represents the current EMR Direct API docs.

MedNet ONC Certified HIT / Cures Update page listing all 43 certified criteria, CQMs, and G1/G2 measures. Lists b(10) EHI export as a certified criterion but provides no documentation or links for it.

Price Transparency / Cost and Considerations document for emr4MD v9.10. 5-page PDF. Contains the ONLY description of the b(10) EHI export: 'This functionality allows a practice to create individual and group exports of PHI without programming intervention.' Notes EMR Direct subscription required. No format, schema, or field-level documentation.

Bun TypeScript enrichment script that extracts structured data from the HTML documentation files. Parses FHIR resource mappings, search parameters, data type choices, and certified criteria into queryable JSON.

Enrichment output: structured extraction of all API documentation including FHIR resource mappings for both 2017 (STU3) and 2026 (R4) API versions, search parameters, data type choices, authentication methods, and the sole EHI export entry from the Price Transparency PDF.
Enrichment output: file processing accounting showing 4 HTML files parsed, 1 PDF metadata extracted, with entity counts per API version.
Documentation for the enrichment scripts: run commands, input boundary, output files, and known parsing limitations.
